summary: Inspected representative files from the LeanBridge LMFDB Modular Forms Level One collection. All files contain formal mathematical content including definitions of modular forms, q-expansion coefficients, minimal polynomials of algebraic numbers, Sturm bound uniqueness theorems, and integer-arithmetic certificates for coefficient verification. The files are organized by weight with pieces for each coefficient of the Hecke field decomposition. Every file contains executable Lean 4 definitions, lemmas, and theorems that constitute formal mathematics relevant to search.
